name: Abhishek Basil Joy
headline: Made for the curious. Not the endless scroll.
subheadline: Original films, visual experiments and reimagined worlds. A quiet corner of the internet for anyone who wants to look closer.
manifesto: I wanted a place for my work to exist without fighting for a few seconds of attention. There is no feed to keep up with here. Just choose something that catches your eye, press play, and take your time.
about: I’m Abhishek Basil Joy — ABJ. I make films, experiment with editing, and follow ideas that refuse to sit neatly inside a template. Some projects are personal, some are playful, and some simply ask a question. This website is where I share them on my own terms.
contact: A film, a collaboration, or an idea that doesn't fit the usual rules. If you think we could make something worth watching, let's talk.

education.degree: Bachelor of Arts in Visual Communication
Post-Graduation Diploma in Social Media Marketing

projects.title: THE WAY BACK
projects.description: A Halloween Eve suspense-mystery short film written and conceived by Deva Nanda K V and Abhishek Basil Joy. Some questions are best left unanswered until the film ends.
projects.subtitle: Written & conceived with Deva Nanda K V.

projects.title: THE SPIN
projects.description: A personal visual piece about anxiety and mental health — the kind of experience that can be difficult to put into words. A project especially close to me.
projects.subtitle: A film about the mind when it refuses to slow down.

projects.title: Breathe.
projects.description: An experimental piece with a simple reminder: when life moves too quickly, do not forget to breathe.
projects.subtitle: Sometimes the simplest thing matters most.

projects.title: TRAIL RUN
projects.description: A trail-day visual experiment filmed by me on an iPhone 17 Pro using its 0.5× ultra-wide lens.
projects.subtitle: Shot on iPhone 17 Pro · Ultra-wide perspective

projects.title: SAPIENS
projects.description: An educational visual documentary exploring the story of humankind and the curiosity that comes with learning where we came from.
projects.subtitle: A visual exploration of human history.

projects.title: DAVID AND GOLIATH
projects.description: An AI reimagining of the familiar David and Goliath story, with a small twist for viewers who pay attention.
projects.subtitle: AI reimagining · An unexpected perspective.

projects.title: RANAM
projects.description: An AI adaptation inspired by the Malayalam film Ranam, created in collaboration with Amal Biju.
projects.subtitle: AI adaptation · With Amal Biju.

projects.title: FIGHT CLUB
projects.description: An AI adaptation inspired by Fight Club, exploring the alter ego, inner conflict and the sides of ourselves we struggle to understand.
projects.subtitle: AI adaptation · The idea of an alter ego.

projects.title: BEYOND THE GIMMICK
projects.description: A response to shallow social-media portrayals of ADHD. It asks viewers to look beyond online trends and take the lived experience seriously.
projects.subtitle: AI visual experiment · Working title.

projects.title: DYBBUK — THE MOSHE FAMILY
projects.description: Part one of a fictional, myth-inspired AI micro short film that imagines a mysterious history around the Jewish settlement in Cochin. This is a work of fiction, not a historical account.
projects.subtitle: AI micro short film · Part I.

projects.title: A DIFFERENT STORY
projects.description: A teaser for part two. What if the history we heard was only one version of the story?
projects.subtitle: AI short film · Part II teaser.

projects.title: INTO THE MINDVERSE
projects.description: An AI superhero short film exploring connected worlds, parallel realities and the possibilities of a multiverse.
projects.subtitle: AI superhero short · Connected worlds.

projects.title: JOHNNY JOHNNY: REIMAGINED
projects.description: A darker take on the familiar Johnny Johnny Yes Papa rhyme, turning a childhood memory into something a little unsettling.
projects.subtitle: AI dark reimagining.

projects.title: TANAKA
projects.description: One of my favourite personal works. A film about looking at life differently, with a quieter thought about freedom and living on your own terms.
projects.subtitle: Chapter 32 · A little freedom between the frames.

projects.title: MONOCHROME
projects.description: A visual experiment inspired by my love for black-and-white cinematography. An exploration of how mood can exist without colour.
projects.subtitle: Black, white and everything between.

projects.title: ESPOIR
projects.description: My visit to Niagara, approached as an experimental visual diary rather than a traditional travel vlog.
projects.subtitle: An unconventional travel diary.

projects.title: ALL THAT GLITTERS
projects.description: Snow, sledding, friends, and Noah the Super Kid. A small winter adventure seen through my camera.
projects.subtitle: A winter day worth keeping.

projects.title: LIVIN'
projects.description: Random moments from my gallery, brought together through editing to create something new out of ordinary footage.
projects.subtitle: A different rhythm for everyday moments.

projects.title: WAKE UP
projects.description: A real-world motion graphics and After Effects experiment — made with traditional editing techniques, not generative AI.
projects.subtitle: Practical editing & visual effects.

projects.title: AGE OF MADNESS
projects.description: A playful and chaotic editing experiment I made with my friend Nikita. Sometimes the idea is simply to try something wild.
projects.subtitle: An edit that does not take itself too seriously.
